name: Marilyn Bowman
bio:
Marilyn Bowman has been helping buyers and sellers across the Greater Baton Rouge Area since 2000. Over her career, she has guided clients through moves in Baton Rouge, Prairieville, Gonzales, Addis, St. Amant, Denham Springs and St. Gabriel. She brings the local knowledge and practical know-how that come from representing both sides of the deal.

Marilyn joined Gaspard & Co Real Estate alongside longtime colleagues, continuing working relationships that feel like family.

Today, Marilyn continues to help buyers find their next home and sellers start their next chapter, bringing more than 25 years of hands-on experience to every client she serves.
